name: Dai Gyakuten! Mujintou wa Rape Paradise
original_name: 大逆転！無人島はレイプパラダイス
source:
There's nothing but ocean in every direction.
Here a guy can REALLY go wild!
Even I, whipped and oppressed by that self-righteous princess,
that sharp-tongued lady boss, that violent lolita, even I can be king
on this solitary island.
The women have nowhere to run.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE144858.html]DLsite English[/url]]
